svg.title: SportGen — Multi-sport SaaS ecosystem — 8 apps (4 web + 4 mobile) for scouting, federation management, CRM, coaches and referees, built around youth-sports training standards.
svg.desc: SportGen: Multi-sport SaaS ecosystem — 8 apps (4 web + 4 mobile) for scouting, federation management, CRM, coaches and referees, built around youth-sports training standards. Ships a 30-criteria player evaluation framework with age-phase weighting and RAE correction. Built with NEXT.JS, REACT NATIVE, TYPESCRIPT, POSTGRESQL, TURBOREPO.
